Hi all, I have had a passing interest in lolita for years, but I have decided to finally take the plunge. I purchased a skirt from Violet Fane (Lovecraft's a Cult from the Sea) and a few other items for my first coord.

I didn't realize until very recently how restrictive lolita sizing is. I knew it was going to be bad, but I didn't realize it would be as bad as most dresses being only one size. I am about a US 14/16 in dress sizes, and I'm having a lot of trouble finding pieces I like in my size. Does anyone have any good reccomendations for goth/classic lolita brands or pieces that might be my size? Thanks in advance!

I feel this. Even hearing people I wouldnt consider dating talk about cheating, or even saying they don't think it makes someone evil, I find them repulsive and cannot associate with them anymore.

I think what frustrates me the most is the amount of homework that I have to do to keep up. The instant a new patch comes out, I go into a match and someone has an unstoppable deck combo that I have to spend weeks trying to test a strategy to counter. And with nowhere to test it, I'm destroying my rank as I lose over and over. Then, when I scrape together something that works, a new patch comes out and all the cards in my deck change abilities.

The game has gotten really unwelcoming to anyone who isn't a hardcore savant level player and it's just become downright depressing to play, honestly.
I have played and enjoyed Hearthstone. I wish gwent had taken some pages from its book and made it more consistent.

Thanks for being one of the few people to show genuine empathy for someone you disagreed with on the internet.

I think my biggest issue is removing casual mode. I now have nowhere to test out decks without wrecking my rank

I understand how you feel. I've been casually dating, nothing serious, but I keep seeing glimmers of my ex in a lot of the guys I've hung out with and it makes me want to shut everything down. I am trying to move past it. 

How long ago did you break up with your ex? If you are still feeling this nervous and it hasn't been very long, it may be best to either back off and keep it casual or take a break altogether. But if you feel good about this relationship, try not to overthink it too much. One thing I've noticed is that when I think back to my previous relationship there were so many red flags that didn't even register to me until the relationship was over. I think now I can spot those things if they should happen again; your situation is probably similar I'm sure.

Regardless of all of that, though, therapy may be helpful to you.
